build.summary: WP6 (Lane B) is built end to end but is NOT done. The pipeline runs register → segment → seam → fill → class codes → metadata → pack → record/report, and the real shirt:10 sheet builds into 검증/옷/top-shirt/ only. That build validates with schema.cjs, gives the same bytes on two runs (sha256), takes about 77 s, renders in the studio runtime for both sexes in 4 views at 280 px, and fails no class code (COLOUR_OFF warnings only). The plan's verification B tolerances are not met: verify-pipeline.py --all ends with 170 failures over 13 cases. The new pipeline files are tools/garment/segment.py, seam.py, fill.py, metadata.py, pack.py, build-garment.py, verify-pipeline.py and garment_synth.py (reusable synth building blocks for WP8). The runtime fixture and its exporter are also in the patch. schema.json/schema.cjs were extended and the reasons recorded: seat.span is new and required for pipeline records; a pipeline record's profile sleeve may leave raisedAt/underarm null because the runtime never raises a profile sleeve; --atlas-dir lets a 검증 build be validated; there are 2 new self-test controls. The patch touches no runtime JS and nothing in 배포용/ or 검증/. Lane A still needs a one-liner in avatar-foundation-outfit.js seatedShorts: `const [L,R]=g.legacy||!T.span?rowSpan(art,F,T.cut-1):T.span`, so the front/back seat stops reading the span from pixels.
done: segment.py: three-way U/T/B labels per figure with per-sheet colour models (skin/product/neighbour/hair), a skin gate, ridge-based drawn layers as the truth, growth over what lies under the product, exposure, below-cuff arm rule (pixels past the cuff seam on the clean arm that changed or look skin-like are arm), neighbour-slot fringe by likelihood ratio (drawn lines excluded), line-art and island rules

seam.py: DP (Viterbi) seams in the frozen cuff/collar/hem/shorts/shoe bands; reward = drawn ridge (outline + connectivity), colour is the tie-breaker; owner prior only on pixels unchanged both by the window-minimum map and pixel by pixel

fill.py: parts split by frozen zones. Unchanged pixels inside the frozen garment keep the frozen ownership; changed paint goes by the product's own lines (front/back cuff carried to its inner end; profile sleeve = the regions its outline encloses: cap arch + cuff band with width from its lower outline, buttons included, falls back on leak). Also: hidden-cloth rebuild (plain-only in profile), 2 px soft fringe alpha, dropping detached strokes, closing small nicks

metadata.py, computed from the packed 8-bit crops: geometric raisedAt (cuff band = region enclosed by its lines; IoU 0.973-0.995 vs the runtime fixture on the drawn sleeve); shirtSide port (exact on legacy layers: edge diff < 1e-4 u); box at 32 px/u over every pinned turn; opening, cuff, hem, collar; bottom edgeTone (row anchored to the frozen shorts rect), waistTop, cuffAlong; seat {cut, apex, cuff, rise (new least-squares rule), span}; sideSeat span (matches the fixture exactly); shoe opening/sole

pack.py: per-sex atlas, encoder writes IHDR/IDAT/IEND only and decode-checks; build-garment.py CLI `<cat:shape[:ci]> --sheet F [--out 검증|assets|DIR]` writes the record JS, atlases, 라벨.png, 부위.png, Korean 등록-보고.png/보고.md/보고.json via report.py, 만들기.json, and runs schema.cjs --builder

Class codes raised from messages.json: limits.measure_top/bottom/shoes (SLEEVE_SHORT/LONG, CAP_HIGH, COLLAR_HIGH, NECK_OPEN, HEM_*, SHORTS_*, SKIRT_LIKE, WAIST_VISIBLE, GHOST_EDGE for legacy legs, shoe codes); UNTINTED_SKIN = tone-invariant (L-8/0/+8) AND skin-likelihood mask AND not explained by the product model AND not a drawn line; VIEW_INCONSISTENT; COLOUR_OFF warning

Real shirt:10 built into 검증/옷/top-shirt/ (not assets/): 77 s, schema ok, codes [], warnings COLOUR_OFF m dE 7.9 / f dE 7.3. Determinism: two builds gave identical sha256 (m e01dd4d0..., f fa41bd5d..., js b9cb8dd8...). All images viewed: label map, parts sheet, registration report

Headless studio preview (?demo=1&session=foundation-studio, register(), no Firebase, no mouse) of both sexes idle front/right/back/left at 280 px: all 8 report garments top:shirt with fallback '' and outfit dressed; viewed

R1 per-part IoU passes everywhere (top 0.972-0.996, bottom 0.992-0.995, shoes 0.981-0.995). Seams within median 1 / max 2 except the collar ends listed under not done. Registration max offset <= 0.5 px. Raised art identity >= 0.97

Other checks pass: check-source exit 0, verify-body-freeze ok, test_register --quick 20/20, schema self-test 58/58, all records + index ok, pack-basic --check ok, build-deployment --check (171 files match)

blocking: Done-criterion 'R1 meets every tolerance in verification B' is NOT met; I reproduced it. `python3 -B tools/garment/verify-pipeline.py --all --out <scratch>/vp-all` exited 1 with '13 case(s), 170 failure(s)' (wall 791 s). Example failures: edge alpha MAE up to 0.109 (f-back torso, webp80; limit .05); dRGB 4.07–7.73 on webp80 (limit 4); underarm edge up to 0.135 u (limit .03) and line dE up to 8.5 (limit 3); f-front edgeTone dE 30.9 on the identity input (limit 3); seat.apex +7 (m-front webp) and m-back seat.cut −3 (limit ±1.5); f-right collar seam max 5.0 px (limit 2); f-front raised1 IoU 0.950 (limit .97). Log: wp6-verify1/logs/vp-all.log, results in vp-all/결과.json.

Geometric positives and the cream synthetic fail (same run). P-sleeve+4 sleeve IoU 0.908–0.947 with seam max 6.32; P-puff1.15 IoU 0.763–0.869; P-hem±6 IoU 0.954–0.969; P-cuff1.15 apex −16/−15 px against the generated truth (f-front/f-back); P-shoe+4 IoU 0.933–0.960; C-cream sleeve IoU 0.809–0.937, seam max 7.62, and 0.56–1.43 % of garment pixels on skin in 5 parts (limit 0.5 %). The comparison images (vp-all/P-sleeve+4.png, C-cream.png) show the extended cuff bottoms in red, i.e. dropped by the pipeline.

Class codes fire on the basic outfit's own round trip and on the positives. The plan says every limit must pass the basic with ≥2 px margin. R1-bottom-identity and R1-bottom-webp80 raise GHOST_EDGE on all 6 figures (10 legs). My r1codes.py found the frozen contact band 3 has 818 px, and 686 of them are uncovered even by the drawn truth (763 by the legacy shorts); they are thigh skin rows 465–472 / 984–996 below the cuff (r1/bottom-identity-m-front-ghost.png). So every shorts that matches the basic is rejected. limits.json has no basic GHOST_EDGE measurement (WP1 marked the basic exempt), and WP6 started raising it for bottoms without checking. R1-top-webp80 raises UNTINTED_SKIN: 20 px each in m-back and f-back, at the inner cuff corners and the f-back nape (r1/top-webp-f-back-skin.png, top-webp-m-back-skin.png). R1-shoes-identity raises VIEW_INCONSISTENT. P-hem+6/−6 raise UNTINTED_SKIN; P-cuff1.15 raises GHOST_EDGE, SKIRT_LIKE, UNTINTED_SKIN and VIEW_INCONSISTENT; P-shoe+4 raises VIEW_INCONSISTENT. verify-pipeline.py run_case only stores res['codes'] and never adds a code to res['fails'], so these false or real codes on known-good inputs pass silently. The builder's report does not mention any of this.

Exposure with no body art never reaches HEM_HIGH, and UNTINTED_SKIN misses plain skin. This was a required REDTEAM fix ('report the exposure as HEM_HIGH evidence'; plan step 3, 'exposure where there is no body art feeds HEM_HIGH'). segment.py:540 computes `noart` (diag exposedNoArtPx) but leaves those pixels labelled product, and nothing reads seg['noart'] or seg['exposed'] (grep). Synthetic negative neg.py belly10: the drawn basic top's last 10 rows on the free hem columns are painted with the arm-skin median, sent through compose → WebP q80 → BG.build. Result: codes [], HEM_HIGH margin went UP from 2–3 to 4–5 px, exposedNoArtPx 757/76/745/714/61/614 per figure, and UNTINTED_SKIN skinPx 0 everywhere, although neg/belly10/부위.png shows a pink skin band baked into every torso. (Control: NECK_OPEN does fire for a 20 px lowered neckline, neck20 → m-front 84, m-back 99, f-front 77 px.)

Done-criterion 'no skin or hair pixels remain in garment layers' fails on the real shirt:10 build, even though UNTINTED_SKIN reports nothing. Very dark brown hair-colour pixels (lum<55, R−B>15, e.g. RGB (28,10,0)–(42,23,9)) sit in the female torso parts: f-front 120 px, f-back 129 px, f-right 19 px, all in the top 13–50 rows and all OUTSIDE the frozen hair-occlusion mask. ChatGPT's bob tips fall outside the template's hair zone, so they were taken as product. Peach skin specks sit at the f-front neck opening and a skin-coloured wedge at the f-back nape. Image: img/f-torso-tops-6x.png. The f-right torso's last rows carry shorts blue, e.g. (74,109,151) at row 153.

Visible art defects in the real build's profile torso. You can see them in the runtime (studio register, wave, 280 px: img/preview-motion-280.png, img/wave-profile-zoom.png). m-right torso: a blocky mosaic patch in the rebuilt cloth, two brown cuff-ring fragments, transparent holes (checker shows through) and a stepped notch in the hem (img/m-right-torso-chk.png). f-right torso: mosaic texture, a pinkish smear, a see-through vertical slit and a dark speck at the collar top (img/f-right-torso-chk.png). The same ring fragments and holes appear in the IDENTITY round trip (vp-all/R1-top-identity.png, m-right/f-right). They are invisible to R1 because part_metrics drops the pipeline's own `hidden` mask from IoU, edge MAE and dRGB. This breaks the flat 1–2-step shading standard.

The cream synthetic does not test cream. garment_synth.cream with one global mask scales every figure by the sheet-wide median lightness. My measurement: girls' 'cream' shirt median RGB is 255,255,255 (dE 21.8 from #f2dfbd, 21.5 from skin); boys' is 188–209,173–193,147–164 (dE 11–18.5 from #f2dfbd, 12.9–19.1 from skin). #f2dfbd itself is only 8.5 dE from the clean-art skin median. So the REDTEAM 'cream garment next to skin' case is not exercised, and a future pass of C-cream would prove nothing. This is also the building block WP8 is meant to reuse.

User decision 2026-10-09 is only half implemented: a colour close to the shop colour keeps a warning, but a noticeably different colour should be sent back to ChatGPT. build-garment.py colour_codes (lines 272–278) only ever appends a COLOUR_OFF warning, with no upper threshold that becomes a failing code, and messages.json COLOUR_OFF is level 'warn'. A uniformly wrong colour (for example red for a blue product) therefore builds with exit 0. VIEW_INCONSISTENT only compares views with each other.
nonBlocking: The R1 truth was changed from 'the current layers' (plan B) to segment.drawn_layers. These are the legacy layers re-cut with the same seam.line_boundary code the pipeline uses, which makes R1 more circular. Measured against today's assets, the drawn truth differs: sleeves IoU f-front 0.951, f-back 0.957, m-right 0.969; shorts f-back 0.979. The new truth alone would already fail the plan's .97/.98 limits. The deviation is in the verify-pipeline docstring but should be recorded as a plan change.
verify-pipeline's registration tolerance is 0.5 px for both paths; the plan sets |dx|,|dy| ≤ .1 px for identity. The measured values pass anyway (identity 0.02–0.027 px, webp80 0.058–0.081 px).
build-garment.py does not call avatar_build.freeze.check(). Plan dataModel: 'build-garment refuses to run on a mismatch'. It only copies bodyFieldsSha256 into the record.

The UNTINTED_SKIN skin-likelihood mask is not exported as a per-record debug PNG (REDTEAM fix). colour_codes accepts a `masks` argument, but build() never passes it. The rule's tone invariance is implemented as a ±8 L sheet shift. It also excludes every pixel within 1 px of a drawn line and needs patches of 12 px or more, so skin nubs against a cuff line can never fire.
The 라벨.png legend reads '보라 몸·다른 옷' (purple = body/other garment), but LABEL_RGB colours only labels 1, 3 and 4. Magenta is label 4 (foreign paint); label 2 (body/other slot) is not drawn.
fill.py:673 swallows ValueError/IndexError from outline_profile/draw_outline without recording it in info, so a failed outline redraw is silent.

The record has 'builder': 'tools/garment/build-garment.py' without @<commit>, which the plan asks for. 'date' defaults to today, so record bytes change from day to day unless --date is given. Atlases are unaffected.

Runtime seat.span on the data path: the front/back seatedShorts still calls rowSpan (avatar-foundation-outfit.js:205) until Lane A applies the documented one-liner. This is lane-locked and the builder recorded it.

The schema loosening (profileFree: a pipeline profile sleeve may have null raisedAt/underarm) is recorded in schema.json and does not mask front/back. My probe: a front sleeve with raisedAt null or underarm null is still LEGACY. The schema does not check that sleeve.box contains the sleeve. My offline check found every opaque hanging and raised pixel of the real build inside its box (max outside 0.0 u).

Lane: export-runtime-fixture.cjs and garment_synth.py are additions outside WP6's file list. Both are inside Lane B's tools/garment/, and the task asked for reusable synth blocks. The patch touches no runtime JS, 배포용/ or 검증/, and has no hard-coded scratch or worktree paths (grep).
